And he took the book out of my possession by force, and went, and I was left an orphan, without the book

So what I remembered, I would continue and go among, in the fields, in the field, and I prayed to Hashem Yisborach that He arrange for me..

I already, I, I was left without the book, but I had the gain that I heard

And he was such a wonder, the like of which does not exist in the world

I grew up among great Chassidim, strict Chassidim, meticulous in the mitzvos and..

Of faith, of Hashem Yisborach, of the Torah, they all study

...Hashem Yisborach knew that Rebbe Yisroel would not move from Meron to Teveria, what did He do?

He sent him an illness on a hand, on, on his hand, and the pains, and very great pain

And the pains intensified from day to day, from hour to hour, such pains that it is impossible to speak one utterance

He could not pray, nor do any service

And he did not, did not attribute anything to the natural way, only

[Everything is the Holy One Blessed Be He]

Everything is the providence of the Creator, when he saw such a thing, then he began to think:

Perhaps it is the Creator’s will that he go to Teveria

What is there in Teveria? In Teveria the climate is warmer than Meron and Tzfas

[And he will be healthy]

He will not be healthy, but, but there will not be such great pains, so that he can pray and occupy himself with the service of Hashem

But nevertheless no, even though he had all such pains and began to think about it

He, he was in doubt, he, he had doubts

Whether he should go, whether he should leave Rebbe Shimon and go to Teveria, whether not

Because he thought perhaps, how is such a thing possible, when a person is in distress, he further flees from Meron, from Rebbe Shimon, to Teveria?

One needs to flee to Rebbe Shimon, to pray, to ask for healing, {not, not to go}

But he was, he was in doubt, perhaps it is the Creator’s will that he go to Teveria, perhaps not

So as long as he did not know clearly, that the Creator’s will was that he go to Teveria, then he would go immediately, but he did not know

So he had hisbodedus, and he asked much of Hashem Yisborach that He illuminate in his thought, in his mind, what to do—if it is the Creator’s will that I go to Teveria, I am traveling immediately to Teveria

So I want to know only what is the Creator’s will, if not, if yes, if yes, if not

So he had hisbodedus about this, and he had doubts, whether to go, whether not to go
